  "last_turn_id" text,

  "problem_id" text,
  "prompt" text,
  "requirements" text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
  "result" text,
  "role" text,
  "source" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PROCESSING' NOT NULL,
  "tailored_resume_id" text,
  "title" text,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_system_design_session_level_check_a955ca61" CHECK ("level" IN ('MID', 'SENIOR', 'STAFF')),

)
